import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ClientProxy, ClientsModule, Transport } from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { firstValueFrom, Observable } from 'rxjs';

const INVENTORY_CLIENT = 'INVENTORY_CLIENT';

function opaqueObservable(source: Observable<unknown>): Observable<unknown> {
  return source;
}

@Injectable()
class ActivationPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject(INVENTORY_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-send-constructed-cold
  constructOnly(): void {
    this.client.send('inventory.lookup', { sku: 'sku-1' });
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-send-first-value
  firstValue(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.client.send('inventory.lookup', { sku: 'sku-1' }));
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-send-subscribed
  subscribe(): void {
    this.client.send('inventory.lookup', { sku: 'sku-1' }).subscribe();
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-send-activation-unknown
  wrapped(): Observable<unknown> {
    return opaqueObservable(this.client.send('inventory.lookup', { sku: 'sku-1' }));
  }
}

@Controller('inventory')
class ActivationController {
  constructor(@Inject(INVENTORY_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-send-route-returned
  @Post('lookup')
  lookup(): Observable<unknown> {
    return this.client.send('inventory.lookup', { sku: 'sku-1' });
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: INVENTORY_CLIENT, transport: Transport.TCP }])],
  controllers: [ActivationController],
  providers: [ActivationPublisher],
})
class ActivationModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: activation');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
